name: Frame Inspector
description: Load a macro, let the bot measure every click's frame window, then play with the windows shown in the level.

toggle-overlay.name: Show / hide everything
toggle-overlay.description: Hides or shows the markers, counter and hardest list while you play.

count-mode.name: Counter counts
count-mode.description: As you click: each number goes up when you hit that click. Passed this attempt: goes up as you pass the clicks. Whole level: totals.

counter-rows.name: Counter rows
counter-rows.description: Where each counter row starts, in frames. Easier: use the Ranges button in the FI menu.

counter-max.name: Counter ends at (frames)
counter-max.description: Everything at this many frames or more goes in the last row (e.g. 30 -> '30+'). 0 = use the Max window you scanned with. Can't go above what you scanned.

marker-mode.name: Circles
marker-mode.description: When you click: a circle with the frame window pops up where you click or release. Always: every circle is shown ahead of time.

show-releases.name: Releases that matter
show-releases.description: Count and show releases, but only the ones that change anything (wave, ship, swing...). Releases with a huge window, like on cube, are always skipped.

marker-decimals.name: Decimals on markers
marker-decimals.description: Show 2.5 instead of 2. Windows under 1 frame always show decimals.

debug-info.name: Show click info
debug-info.description: A small line in the bottom left that says what your last click matched (or why it didn't). Handy if circles or dings don't show up.

attempt-banner.name: 1 frames banner
attempt-banner.description: Every new attempt, show how many 1 frames (and under 1 frame clicks) the level has.

ding.name: Ding on hard clicks
ding.description: Plays a ding when you hit a click or release (robot, wave, ship...) that's this hard or harder.

ding-max-frames.name: Ding up to (frames)
ding-max-frames.description: 1 = only frame perfects (and under). 2 = also 2 frames, etc.

ding-file.name: Custom ding sound
ding-file.description: Optional: pick your own .ogg/.mp3/.wav instead of the built-in ding.

scan-releases.name: Scan releases
scan-releases.description: Also measure releases (needed for wave/ship/swing). Turning this off makes scans faster.

extra-survive-ticks.name: Extra survive ticks
extra-survive-ticks.description: A shifted click must keep you alive until your next click happens, plus this many ticks.

fast-scan.name: Fast scan
fast-scan.description: Skip drawing level objects while the bot fast-forwards. Turn off if a scan behaves differently from normal play.

scan-budget-ms.name: Scan time per frame (ms)
scan-budget-ms.description: How long the bot works each frame. Higher = faster scan but laggier screen.
